definitions.gloss: unhealthy; unwholesome; bad for one's health
definitions.explanation: Describing a state, habit, or condition that is harmful to physical or mental health, or a person who is not in good health.

examples.japanese: {不健康|ふけんこう}な⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I am living an unhealthy diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不健康|ふけんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もとだ。
examples.english: Staying up late is a source of poor health.

examples.japanese: {不健康|ふけんこう}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦とうとう→とうとう：00900_toutou⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}して→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧しまった。
examples.english: After continuing an unhealthy lifestyle, I finally ruined my health.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {不|ふ} (un-, non-) + ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (health, healthy). Functions as both a na-adjective ({不健康|ふけんこう}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧) and a noun ({不健康|ふけんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと).

FORMS:
- Modifier: {不健康|ふけんこう}な + noun
- Predicate: {不健康|ふけんこう}だ

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不健康|ふけんこう}な⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ (unhealthy diet)
- {不健康|ふけんこう}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (unhealthy lifestyle)
- {不健康|ふけんこう}そうな⟦{顔色|かおいろ}→顔色：25468_kaoiro⟧ (unhealthy-looking complexion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧: healthy — the opposite, describing good health
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: bad for the body — a more casual way to say something is unhealthy
